title: Fraud and Anomaly Review
summary: Duplicate payment and vendor master checks, unusual journal testing, expense policy checks and payroll anomaly review.
metaTitle: Fraud and Anomaly Review: Data Checks on Your Books
metaDescription: One-time fraud and anomaly review: duplicate payments, vendor checks, unusual journals, expense claims and payroll anomalies, with an evidence-backed report.
heroIntro: Data-driven checks across payments, journals, expenses and payroll, with an evidence-backed report of what looks wrong.
overview: Most irregularities leave patterns in the data: the same invoice paid twice, journals posted at odd times, round-sum entries, employees who do not exist. We test for them across your accounting and payroll data and report what we find with evidence.
whatWeDo: Duplicate payment and vendor master checks.
Unusual journal entry and round-sum testing.
Payroll checks for ghost employees and unusual changes.
whoFor: Businesses that suspect leakage or want reassurance.
Companies after a change in finance staff.
Boards and owners who are not close to day-to-day finance.
duration: One-time project, with an evidence-backed report.

faqs.a: No. It is an analytical review that flags anomalies for follow-up. If something serious emerges, you may need specialist forensic or legal support.
